title: Implement Database Schema for Schedule Events
description: Create the database schema for storing user schedule events using Drizzle ORM, including tables for events, chat messages, and AI insights as specified in the PRD.
details: Define the database schema in a new file (e.g., `src/lib/db/schema.ts`) using Drizzle ORM. Create tables for: 1) `events` table with fields for user_id, title, date, start_time, end_time, type, created_at, updated_at; 2) `chat_messages` table for storing conversation history; 3) `ai_insights` table for analytics data. Ensure proper foreign key relationships and indexes for performance. Run migrations to create the tables in PostgreSQL. Include proper TypeScript types for all schema definitions.
test_strategy: Write unit tests to verify schema definitions are valid and migrations run successfully. Test database connections and basic CRUD operations on each table.

title: Integrate AI Chat API with Schedule Parsing
description: Enhance the existing `/api/chat` endpoint to integrate with OpenAI GPT-4 using Vercel AI SDK, implementing function calling to parse natural language schedule input into structured JSON.
details: Modify `app/api/chat/route.ts` to: 1) Install and configure Vercel AI SDK with OpenAI provider; 2) Implement function calling/tools to extract schedule events from natural language (title, date, startTime, endTime, type); 3) Add validation for parsed data; 4) Save structured events to the database using Drizzle ORM; 5) Return both conversational responses and structured confirmations; 6) Handle streaming responses for real-time user feedback. Include proper error handling for AI API failures and rate limiting.
test_strategy: Mock OpenAI API responses to test parsing logic. Create unit tests for various natural language inputs and verify correct JSON structure output. Test database insertion and error handling scenarios.

title: Build Chat Interface with assistant-ui
description: Implement the conversational chat interface using assistant-ui library and @ai-sdk/react hooks, providing users with a natural language input method for schedule management.
details: Install and integrate `assistant-ui` library into the application. Create a chat component that: 1) Uses @ai-sdk/react hooks for streaming responses; 2) Connects to the `/api/chat` endpoint; 3) Displays conversation history; 4) Shows typing indicators and loading states; 5) Handles both text responses and structured event confirmations; 6) Integrates with the existing shadcn/ui design system. Place the chat interface on the main page or dashboard as specified in the user flow. Ensure responsive design for desktop and tablet.
test_strategy: Test chat interface with various user inputs. Verify streaming responses work correctly. Test error states and loading indicators. Ensure accessibility compliance with keyboard navigation and screen readers.

title: Update Dashboard to Display Schedule Data
description: Modify the dashboard page and calendar component to fetch and display user schedule events from the database, integrating with the existing calendar-view component.
details: Update `app/dashboard/page.tsx` to: 1) Create server actions or API routes to fetch user's schedule events; 2) Implement proper authentication checks to ensure users only see their own data; 3) Pass schedule data to the calendar component. Modify `components/dashboard/calendar-view.tsx` to: 1) Accept and render schedule events; 2) Display events with proper time formatting; 3) Handle different event types with color coding; 4) Ensure responsive layout. Use Next.js caching mechanisms for optimal performance.
test_strategy: Test data fetching with authenticated users. Verify calendar displays events correctly across different time periods. Test with various event types and edge cases like overlapping events.

title: Implement Schedule Analytics and Insights
description: Create analytics functionality to compute and display schedule insights such as meeting density, free-time ratio, and focus blocks on the dashboard metrics component.
details: Develop server-side functions to: 1) Calculate meeting density (meetings per day/week); 2) Compute free-time ratio; 3) Identify and count focus blocks; 4) Generate insights and store them in the `ai_insights` table. Update `components/dashboard/metrics-chart.tsx` to: 1) Display computed metrics in cards or charts; 2) Show trends over time; 3) Provide actionable insights to users. Implement caching for analytics to avoid recalculating on every page load. Include proper error handling and fallback states.
test_strategy: Test analytics calculations with various schedule patterns. Verify metrics accuracy with edge cases like empty schedules or heavily booked days. Test chart rendering and responsive behavior.
